policy.state_rule: Every governed simulation state binds world identity, monotonic tick, canonical rule digest, explicit uncertainty, immutable deterministic values, and parent-state lineage.
policy.authority_rule: Simulation states, actions, evidence, and permits are simulation-only and cannot authorize real-world facts, postconditions, network writes, filesystem writes, process execution, or other external side effects.
policy.resource_rule: Rollouts fail closed before execution when depth, branching, total nodes, state bytes, action bytes, compute units, uncertainty, or declared capability scope exceed the active budget.
